DESCRIPTION: Flip a light card to its cursed face. Cursed faces are stronger, cost at least #b1, #ySeal themselves after being played and return to hand, and #yBacklash if still in hand at end of turn.
Flip a cursed card back to its light face.
#yErode or #ySeal a card. Each flip adds 1 #yChime this turn.
Flips this turn. Elf cards deal + Chime damage per hit and gain + Chime #yBlock.
At end of turn, lose #b2 HP for each cursed card in your hand.
